verdict.rationale: Wise Business documents receiving payments via local account details in 40+ currencies/160+ countries (wise-docs-1,3,9,12), but concrete hands-on reports show these account details can change with zero notice, breaking real business payment flows with enterprise clients on NET30/90 terms (wise-comm-3, wise-comm-5), and one founder's entire business account was blocked due to a category mismatch (wise-comm-6). Missing for 10: independent verification of stability of account details over time, and resolution/track record after the reported incidents.
